nodes.name: HMAC SHA256 Signature
nodes.notes: HMAC secret: after import, paste the Quorum HMAC secret into this node's Secret field (typeVersion 1, portable). On n8n ≥ 2.7 prefer Crypto credentials: switch this node to typeVersion 2, create Crypto credentials with Hmac Secret, attach them. Never commit real secrets. Advanced: Secret = {{ $env.QUORUM_HMAC_SECRET }} with process env.

quorumSetup: 1. Prefer Connect n8n (polling) in Quorum when you can — no workflow changes.
2. For push: in Quorum register push, issue credential, activate monitoring (else HTTP 409 CONTRACT_NOT_ACTIVE).
3. Copy Quorum workflow ID, Key ID, HMAC secret (not the n8n workflow ID).
4. Import this workflow. Edit node "Quorum Setup (edit me)": quorumBaseUrl, quorumWorkflowId, keyId.
5. HMAC secret: paste into Crypto HMAC Secret (typeVersion 1 export), or on n8n ≥ 2.7 switch HMAC node to Crypto v2 + Crypto credentials (Hmac Secret).
6. No NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN. No container env for the normal path. Activate and confirm HTTP 202.
7. Advanced: Docker/K8s process env QUORUM_* (+ N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false on n8n 2.x) — see examples/n8n/README.md.
meta.supportedN8nRange: 1.95.3 – current stable (Crypto typeVersion 1 export; Crypto credentials preferred on >= 2.7.0)
meta.cryptoNode: n8n-nodes-base.crypto typeVersion 1 (Secret parameter, filled in n8n UI after import). Crypto credentials require typeVersion 2 (n8n >= 2.7.0).

placeholders.quorumWorkflowId: REPLACE_QUORUM_WORKFLOW_ID in Quorum Setup (edit me) — Quorum id, not n8n URL id
placeholders.hmacSecret: REPLACE_HMAC_SECRET_IN_N8N_UI on Crypto HMAC node, or Crypto credentials on >= 2.7
